questions.message: G001“get a job”范围很宽，是否保留为顶层目标，还是仅作为 G003 的背景？
提交冷却目标来自抱怨推断，是否应作为产品改进目标保留？
性能反馈一致性目标同样来自抱怨，是否保留？
只练未勾选题可能只是平台操作步骤，是否应独立成目标？
T019 与 T029 的时间阈值不一致，是否需拆分或只保留较具体的一组？

relations.rationale: 为求职面试做准备是实现获得工作这一总体目的的途径；原文说练习的主要目的就是找工作。

evidence_quotes.quote: the main purpose is just to get a job

conditions: 公司题目来自 LeetCode 或其变体
relations.rationale: 在 LeetCode 练习是因为公司从这里取题，因此该方式服务于面试准备。

evidence_quotes.quote: all the companies take questions or variations of the questions from the leetcode, and it's the primary reason I use leetcode

relations.rationale: NeetCode 的精简分类清单被明确用于练习面试题，服务于面试准备。

evidence_quotes.quote: I used NeetCode to practice the questions specific for job interviews.

relations.rationale: 临面试前每天练习使准备更充分，对面试准备有贡献但非充分条件。

evidence_quotes.quote: Because after you practice right before the interview, your your brain is more functioning and you can prepare better

relations.rationale: 按朋友分享的真题号练习可提升面试准备度，原文明确说因此更 prepared。

evidence_quotes.quote: So he just sent me, like the the leetcode question numbers to me, so I can directly practice the the question numbers and and get used to it, so I can be more prepared for my interviews

relations.rationale: 看到做题数量带来的信心使面试答题更自信、少紧张，对面试表现有帮助。

evidence_quotes.quote: So in my job interview I can be more confident and not be so nervous when I am answering questions

relations.rationale: GeeksforGeeks 的详细解法讲解帮助他在看解法阶段理解题目，对 G017 的理解步骤有贡献。

evidence_quotes.quote: I mainly use it to find find a like more explained solution

relations.rationale: 超时后在同类题上加练可改善下次表现，服务于按难度的时间目标。

evidence_quotes.quote: I will just try to practice more on this category of questions, so I can do better next time.

relations.rationale: 预留大块无干扰时间是完成每日练习的条件性帮助，非充分保证。

evidence_quotes.quote: you need to like allocate a good chunk of the time for you to sit down and go through the practice go through the problems like more patiently
